entities.summary: Marcin Janusz is a Polish professional volleyball player who plays as a setter for Asseco Resovia. Janusz is a former member of the Poland national team, a silver medallist of the 2024 Summer Olympics and the 2022 World Championship, as well as a two–time Champions League winner with ZAKSA.
